ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity pixels (~90-95% black/dark gray) with minimal high-intensity pixels (~5-10% light gray highlights) concentrated in faint vertical streaks and along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow V-shaped depression with obscured vertex pixels due to deep shadow saturation; estimated internal angle exceeds 130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; peaks are approximately 3-8 pixels in height relative to adjacent valleys, with increased prominence on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory from the median notch transitioning into a convex sweep towards the tapered, slightly posterior-pointing lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct vertical dark linear disruption (~20-30 pixels in length) located on the outer third of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear scar on the right fluke lobe; irregular micro-notches on the distal trailing edges that deviate from the standard serration frequency.
